values.description: Your sandbox API key. Create one at https://onchainrisk.io/dashboard/api-keys (free tier allows 1).

Replace with the address you want to inspect. Sandbox graph supports 13 networks (11 of the 14 EVM networks, plus bsc and tron; linea, fantom and polygon_zkevm are excluded and return 422). See capability-matrix.md for the current endpoint-specific set.
